cards.title: User API
cards.summary: Receives requests to create and read user accounts.
cards.content:
# User API

Illustrative API boundary.

## Endpoints

- `POST /users`
- `GET /users/{id}`

## Responsibility

Validate request shape and delegate user operations to User Service.

cards.title: User Service
cards.summary: Applies user account rules and coordinates persistence.
cards.content:
# User Service

Illustrative application service.

## Responsibilities

- Apply user account rules.
- Coordinate reads and writes.

## Request flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    API[User API] --> Service[User Service]
    Service --> DB[(Database)]
```

## Open question

How should duplicate account requests be handled? The diagram does not establish that rule.
